_about: TTS test set for transcription accuracy. 'say' is what the Hoda (ar-EG) voice speaks: English terms are spelled the way Egyptians pronounce them. '|' = pause mid-sentence (must NOT end the sentence), '||' = pause between sentences. 'ref' is the correct transcript, 'terms' the English words that must come out in Latin letters.
